svg.text: Capability comparison across seven pegRNA design tools
Entry point is allele comparison (WT vs reference CDS)
CDS to genomic coordinate mapping through introns
Plant-calibrated PBS Tm and length rules
Multi-channel PBS free-energy landscape (3 scored channels)
Free-energy-selected 3′ linker from a candidate pool
Pol III promoter constraints (5′ G, poly-T)
Restriction-site conflict scan of the insert
Multiple assembly chemistries with strategy switching
Cloning primers with per-primer thermodynamic QC
PCR cycling conditions from actual primer Tm
Reports PBS Tm on both nearest-neighbour and Wallace scales
Design record can be re-imported and re-verified
Published automated test suite against known designs
Complete design record export (all candidates, all sub-scores)
Spacer candidates returned per target (this study, n = 7)
All computation client-side; sequences never uploaded
